about: The anchor check's level 0 (tools/gauntlet/report.py; .github/workflows/gauntlet.yml downloads the gauntlet-result artifacts of the two runs named here, kept 90 days; tools/gauntlet/archive.sh keeps every run in ~/fork-data/gauntlet/run-ID, which report.py --archive reads). previous: the last gauntlet, compared with the next one. baseline: the gauntlet the running transfer ratio starts from. adopted: every change adopted after the baseline's commit, with its self-play (SPRT) logistic Elo and ci95, the half-width of its 95% interval. After each gauntlet, set previous to it; add each adopted change. Starting values: docs/research/transfer-testing/report.md, sections 1.1 and 1.2.
